sources.title: kgrozdanovski/caldec-ultra-380m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A typed-decision model for long assistant states. It puts a Laya-format decision head on dmis-lab/UltraBERT-380M, reads states of up to 8,192 tokens, and answers all of a case's questions in one encoder pass. Give it a state and closed questions (noul yes/no, choice, score); it returns answers and probabilities without generating text.

sources.title: kgrozdanovski/caldec-v1-laya · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A fine-tuned 421M-parameter Laya encoder for closed assistant decisions. It accepts a state and typed questions, and returns answers and probabilities without generating text. The self-contained repository contains model.safetensors, rl_agent_config.json, tokenizer files and encoder config.
